topic: 专项练习 - 现在完成时与一般过去时的辨析及时间状语 (Present Perfect vs. Past Simple)

questions.question: Emma ______ her keys this morning, so she cannot unlock the front door now.
questions.explanation: 句中虽然提到了钥匙丢失的动作，但后半句强调该动作对现在造成的影响（现在无法开门），应用现在完成时强调对现在的结果影响。

questions.question: Our class ______ the Natural History Museum two days ago.
questions.explanation: “two days ago”（两天前）是明确的过去时间状语，必须使用一般过去时，动词 visit 变为 visited。

questions.question:
— Where is Toby?
— He ______ to the school library to return some books. He will be back soon.
questions.explanation: “have/has gone to” 表示“去了某地，尚未返回”；“have/has been to” 表示“去过某地，现已回来”。根据“He will be back soon”可知人还在图书馆，故选 has gone。

questions.question: I ______ this exciting adventure novel yet. I am still on chapter four.
questions.explanation: “yet” 常用于现在完成时的否定句或疑问句句末，表示“尚，还”，因此选用否定形式 haven't finished。

questions.question: Mr. Harrison has taught Science in this international school ______ ten years.
questions.explanation: 在现在完成时中，表示一段时间的持续长度（a period of time，如 ten years）应使用介词 “for”；若为时间起点则用 “since”。

questions.question: Chloe has played the cello ______ she was six years old.
questions.explanation: “she was six years old” 表示动作开始的过去具体时间点，引导从句作时间起点时应使用 “since”。

questions.question:
— ______ you ever ______ a giant panda in person?
— Yes, I saw one in Chengdu last summer.
questions.explanation: 句中含有标志词 “ever”（曾经），常用于现在完成时询问人生经历，结构为 “Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词”。

questions.question: Lucas ______ an email to his pen pal in Canada yesterday evening.
questions.explanation: “yesterday evening”（昨天傍晚）是具体的过去时间，句子动作已经结束，应使用一般过去时 sent。

questions.question:
— Would you like some apple pie?
— No, thanks. I have ______ had my lunch.
questions.explanation: “already” 意为“已经”，常用于现在完成时的肯定陈述句中，位于助动词 have/has 与过去分词之间。

questions.question: When ______ your family ______ to this green neighborhood?
questions.explanation: 疑问词 “when” 针对具体的过去时间点提问，通常与一般过去时连用，不能与现在完成时连用，因此用 did ... move。

questions.question: Look at the floor! The puppy ______ a glass bottle and spilled milk everywhere.
questions.explanation: “Look at the floor!” 提示看现在的现场，打碎瓶子的动作对现在的地面造成了影响，强调动作的现状与后果，使用现在完成时 has broken。

questions.question: My grandparents ______ Paris three times. They know the city very well.
questions.explanation: “have been to + 地点” 表示“曾经去过某地”，强调去过并已回来，后接表示频次的 “three times” 说明经历。

questions.question: The painter ______ this portrait back in 1895.
questions.explanation: “in 1895” 是明确的过去历史年份，属于确定过去时间，谓语动词须用一般过去时 completed。

questions.question: We ______ friends since our first day in kindergarten.
questions.explanation: “since + 过去的时间点” 通常与现在完成时搭配，表示友谊从幼儿园第一天一直持续到现在，故用 have been。

questions.question: Sammy isn't hungry because he has ______ finished a large cheese pizza.
questions.explanation: “just” 意为“刚刚”，常放在助动词 has 与过去分词之间，表示动作刚刚发生完并对现在产生影响。

questions.question:
— Did you watch the basketball finals last Saturday?
— Yes, our school team ______ really well and won the trophy.
questions.explanation: 问句由 “Did you watch ... last Saturday” 设定了过去时间背景，回答过去的比赛表现需用一般过去时 played。

questions.question: Mia has ______ traveled on an airplane. Today is her very first flight!
questions.explanation: 根据后句“今天是她人生第一次飞行”，可知她之前“从不/从未”坐过飞机，故选否定词 never。

questions.question: What time ______ you ______ your homework last night?
questions.explanation: “last night” 为明确的过去时间状语，一般过去时的疑问句需借助助动词 did，后接动词原形 do。

questions.question: Scientific researchers ______ a brand-new species of frog in the rainforest recently.
questions.explanation: “recently”（最近）常作为现在完成时的标志词，用来陈述近期发生且具有现时意义的发现成果。

questions.question: Uncle Tom ______ his bicycle to work every day when he lived in Oxford.
questions.explanation: “when he lived in Oxford” 表明该习惯性动作完全发生在过去的阶段，现已结束，故用一般过去时 rode。

questions.question:
— Have you packed your swimming gear ______?
— Yes, Mum. Everything is in the bag.
questions.explanation: 在现在完成时的一般疑问句句末，表示“已经/是否完成”应使用 “yet”。

questions.question: The little boy fell down and ______ his left knee a moment ago.
questions.explanation: “a moment ago”（刚才）是明确的过去时间，且与 fell 并列，动词 hurt 的过去式依然是 hurt。

questions.question: How long ______ you ______ this golden retriever?
questions.explanation: “How long” 针对持续的时间段提问，表示从过去某个时间一直拥有到现在，动词 have 的现在完成时是 have had。

questions.question: Oliver ______ in London for three years before his parents moved to Singapore.
questions.explanation: 虽然有 “for three years”，但该居住状态在“搬到新加坡”之前就已经结束，并没有持续到现在，因此应用一般过去时 lived。

questions.question: I ______ this robotic toy last Christmas, but I ______ it since February.
questions.explanation: 前一分句有确定的过去时间 “last Christmas”，用一般过去时 received；后一分句有 “since February”，用现在完成时 haven't used。

questions.question: Look at the rainbow! The heavy rain ______.
questions.explanation: 看到彩虹是现在的现象，表明暴雨“已经停止”，雨停的动作与现在直接相关，强调当前结果，故用 has stopped。

questions.question:
— Where are the freshly baked cookies?
— Oh, David ______ them all ten minutes ago!
questions.explanation: 句末出现 “ten minutes ago”（十分钟前）这一明确的过去时间标志词，谓语动词应选用一般过去时 ate。

questions.question: We cannot enter the computer lab because the technician ______ it.
questions.explanation: 主句说明现状（现在进不去），原因在于技师“锁上了门”，这个过去发生的动作直接影响了现在，故用现在完成时 has locked。

questions.question: Miss Carter ______ in Canada when she was a university student.
questions.explanation: “when she was a university student” 限定了动作发生于过去读书的阶段，现已不是大学生，属于过去的历史事实，用一般过去时 studied。

questions.question: This is the third time that our debate team ______ the regional championship.
questions.explanation: 在“This is the first/second/third time that...”等固定句型中，从句通常使用现在完成时，表示到目前为止累计实现的次数，故选 has won。
